name: Schedule 🥔
desc:
Buy and grow powerful chips, then use machines to turn them into pure profit., build your underground money empire and upgrade your entire operation to keep the cash flowing!
Can you master the system and run the most powerful chip business around? 💰

🌱 Grow and harvest your own potatoes
🏭 Turn them into crunchy, golden chips in your own factory
🛒 Sell your tasty creations to hungry customers and watch the cash roll in
🏠 Buy real estate and expand your snack empire to new heights
🕹️ Play anywhere—PC, console, or phone
🎤 Even better with friends and voice chat for maximum fun

Tags:  Money, Business, Empire, Factory, Strategy, Boss, Cash, Crime-Inspired, Underground, Power, Schedule, Schedule X
